_comment: Names and terms the demo has to say correctly and recognise reliably. See vocabulary.py for how each field is used, and how to derive a new say_as with espeak-ng.
_names: say_as is a respelling fed to TTS instead of the real name, because espeak-ng mispronounces most non-English names. heard_as lists what STT has actually been observed to emit -- add to it whenever you catch a new one.

names.name: Marija
names._ipa: mˈɑːɹiə -- MAH-ree-a, stress on the first syllable. Chosen by ear over Mahreeya.

names.name: Kranti
names._ipa: kɹˈɑːnti -- KRAHN-tee, hard a. Chosen by ear over Kranntee, which rendered as KRAYN-tee.

_terms: Plain substitutions applied to any text before TTS. Acronyms are the main offender: stock TTS reads NXP as a word.
